newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq slips slightly amid profit warnings.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq slips slightly amid profit warnings.

text.p: Nasdaq shares dropped slightly on Tuesday as profit warnings by several firms eroded Monday's gains, traders said.

The Nasdaq composite index lost 3.82 points or 0.26 percent to 1438.25. Losing issues beat advancing issues 2322 to 1967 on total volume of 591 million shares. Nasdaq shares lost ground despite a 50 point gain in the Dow industrials, which closed unofficially at 7722.
"Everyday, there's a few more companies saying that the second quarter might not be that hot. These warnings just kind of eat away at the market," one trader said.
Dell Computer Corp reminded analysts that the second quarter is "not historically a strong one," Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette said in a research report. Dell lost 3-1/16 to 114-3/8.

Shares of both Cellular Technical Services Co and VideoServer Inc dropped after each firm warned it would post a loss in the second quarter. UroHealth Systems Inc also slipped after it said its June quarter revenues will be lower than previously expected.
Staples Inc gained 1-1/16 to 24-5/16 despite a judge's ruling on Monday that was expected to kill its proposed merger with Office Depot Inc.
